# North Refractories

> > A leading manufacturer of thermal insulation and refractory materials for high-temperature industrial applications across aerospace, automotive, petrochemical, and power generation sectors.

North Refractories specializes in advanced thermal insulation solutions including ceramic fiber, calcium silicate, microporous, and aerogel materials. The company serves multiple industries requiring reliable high-temperature insulation products with custom machining and specialized product lines.

## Key Topics

- Thermal Insulation Materials
- Refractory Materials
- Ceramic Fiber Insulation
- Calcium Silicate Insulation
- Microporous Insulation
- Aerogel Insulation
- Alumina Continuous Fiber
- AES Fiber Insulation
- Carbon Fiber Products
- High-Temperature Insulation
- Industrial Applications
- Aerospace & Automotive
- Petrochemical & Refinery
- Power Generation
- Custom Machining

## Product Catalog

- [Types of Thermal Insulation Materials List](https://www.northrefractories.com/products): Main product catalog listing calcium silicate, ceramic fiber, and microporous insulation offerings.
- [Ceramic Fiber Insulation](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/ceramic-fiber-insulation): Ceramic fiber insulation blankets and boards for high temperature applications.
- [Calcium Silicate Thermal Insulation Material](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/calcium-silicate-insulation): Calcium silicate insulation boards in various densities and temperature grades.
- [Microporous Thermal Insulation Board](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/microporous-insulation): Microporous insulation boards NR 1000°C, 1050°C, 1200°C product line.
- [Aerogel Thermal Insulation Material](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/aerogel-insulation): Aerogel insulation boards, blankets, sheets, and powder products.
- [Alumina Continuous Fiber](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/alumina-continuous-fiber): Polycrystalline alumina oxide fiber products including yarn, tape, rope, and cloth.
- [AES Fiber Insulation](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/aes-fiber-insulation): Bio-soluble alkaline earth silicate fiber products including blanket, cloth, rope, and boards.
- [Carbon Fiber Products](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/carbon-fiber-products): Carbon fiber sleeves, cloth, mat, and yarn for thermal insulation applications.

## Calcium Silicate Solutions

- [High Density Calcium Silicate Board](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/high-density-calcium-silicate-board): High density calcium silicate boards for aluminum casting and foundry insulation.
- [Lightweight Calcium Silicate Products](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/light-weight-calcium-silicate-products): Lightweight calcium silicate slabs and fire-resistant insulation shields.
- [Custom Calcium Silicate Machined Parts](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/custom-calcium-silicate-machined-parts): Custom machined calcium silicate parts for industrial high-temperature applications.

## Microporous Insulation Series

- [NR 1000°C Classic Insulation Boards](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/nr-1000c-classic-insulation-boards.html): NR 1000°C microporous insulation boards with detailed specifications.
- [NR 1050°C Classic Insulation Boards](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/nr-1050c-classic-insulation-boards.html): NR 1050°C microporous insulation boards with product features and applications.
- [NR 1200°C Classic Insulation Boards](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/nr-1200c-classic-insulation-boards.html): NR 1200°C microporous insulation boards for high-temperature thermal insulation.
- [Flexible Microporous Boards](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/flexible-microporous-boards.html): Flexible microporous boards NR 1000 flex with low thermal conductivity.
- [Flexible Microporous Panels](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/flexible-microporous-panels.html): Flexible microporous panels NR 1000 sflex for heat transfer reduction.

## Alumina Fiber Products

- [Alumina Fiber Yarn](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/alumina-fiber-yarn.html): Alumina fiber yarn ALF for high-temperature aerospace and composite applications.
- [Alumina Fiber Tape](https://www.northrefractories.com/products/alumina-fiber-tape.html): Alumina fiber braided tape for high-temperature thermal protection.
